_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja ChildsRoom/Pokoj Dziecka (66 terminow, ~19 mikroscen) - dawny pokoj dziecka o morskim motywie, obecnie warsztat iluzjonisty Symmetry (wspomniany 'medalion Sym'). Zawiera magiczne rekwizyty (szafka do znikania, karty, kubki, laska stojaca samodzielnie).
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci.
_meta.uwagi_tlumaczeniowe: Dice/ds2: gra slowna 'dice'(l.mnoga)/'die'(l.pojedyncza, takze 'umrzec') zaadaptowana funkcjonalnie jako prosta korekta gramatyczna liczby pojedynczej bez zachowania dwuznacznosci 'umrzec'.

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_BG/Section.en: An old fashioned child's room with an ocean theme.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_BG/Section.pl: Staromodny pokój dziecięcy w morskim motywie.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_BG/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_BG/Section.en: Currently being used as a magician's workshop.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_BG/Section.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_Dice/Sectio.en: Hey look, Sally, it's a giant dice.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_Dice/Sectio.pl: Hej, patrz, Sally, to wielka kostka do gry.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_Dice/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_LockedBoxSt.en: What's all this stuff on the top?
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_LockedBoxSt.pl: Co to za rzeczy na górze?
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_LockedBoxSt.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_LocketPromp.en: Let's take a look at Sym's locket...
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_LocketPromp.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_Newspaper/S.en: A page ripped out of a newspaper...
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_Newspaper/S.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_juggling/Se.en: Why did that feel like an insult?
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_juggling/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_juggling/Se.en: Grimoire, you look like the kind of guy who can juggle.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_juggling/Se.pl: Grimoire, wyglądasz jak facet, który umie żonglować.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_juggling/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_juggling/Se.en: I don't hear you denying it.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_juggling/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_painting1/S.en: An... eerie painting of a girl standing in the woods.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_painting1/S.pl: Niepokojący... obraz dziewczynki stojącej w lesie.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_painting1/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_seahorse/Se.en: It's a sea horse rocking horse!
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_seahorse/Se.pl: To konik na biegunach w kształcie konika morskiego!
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_seahorse/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_seahorse/Se.en:
I don't know.
Are you a [i]small Victorian child?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_seahorse/Se.pl:
Nie wiem.
Czy jesteś [i]małym dzieckiem z epoki wiktoriańskiej?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_seahorse/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_starfish/Se.en: Now I heard - if you cut a starfish in half, both halves regenerate into a new starfish.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_starfish/Se.pl: Słyszałam, że jeśli przetniesz rozgwiazdę na pół, obie połówki zregenerują się w nowe rozgwiazdy.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_starfish/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_starfish/Se.en: Yeah. I can do that too.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_starfish/Se.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_starfish/Se.en: Also, they have no brain and no blood.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_starfish/Se.pl: Poza tym nie mają mózgu ani krwi.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_starfish/Se.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_submarine/S.en: I think it's a doll's house.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_submarine/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_walking sti.en: A walking stick, standing up by itself.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_walking sti.pl: Laska, stojąca sama, o własnych siłach.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_walking sti.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_walking sti.en: ...I think it's part of an illusion.
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_walking sti.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_wardrobe/Se.en:
I think it's just a wardrobe.
Let's take a look inside...
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_wardrobe/Se.pl:
Chyba to po prostu szafa.
Zajrzyjmy do środka...
Examine/Exam_Area_ChildsRoom_wardrobe/Se.speaker: Grimoire
